## Pack

<!--
Paste the JSON entry generated by Mappa:
«Поделиться паком» → «Создать торрент» → licence → «Скопировать запись каталога».
Replace the example below.
-->

```json
{
  "id": "region-provider-12345678",
  "name": "Region",
  "bbox": [0, 0, 1, 1],
  "zoom": [10, 16],
  "provider": "osm",
  "bytes": 1000000,
  "infoHash": "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  "magnet": "magnet:?xt=urn:btih:0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  "license": "ODbL",
  "publisher": "your-name",
  "publishedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

## Checklist

- [ ] I have the right to distribute this pack.
- [ ] The magnet and info hash match the torrent.
- [ ] The pack is seeded (at least one peer is online).
- [ ] Licence and source are stated.
